name: Chickpea, Tahini & Harissa Smash
notes:
A smoosh with Middle Eastern flavours like tahini and harissa, served on bagels.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 2 romano peppers
• 50g fresh parsley
• 1 × 350g jar chickpeas
• 1 tbsp vegan mayonnaise
• 1 tsp tahini
• 2 tsp harissa paste
• 1½ tbsp white wine vinegar
• 1 lemon
• 1 tbsp sesame seeds
• 2 bagels

Method:
1. Dice the peppers into small cubes and finely chop the parsley.
2. Combine everything in a bowl, juicing in the lemon, and season generously with salt and pepper.
3. Smoosh over the bagels (or toast or pitta), then sprinkle over the sesame seeds and any remaining parsley.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 2g, fibre 15g, sugars 14g, sodium 1042mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/chickpea-tahini-harissa-smoosh
